identity.name: Sensitive Data Local Staging and Password-Protected Archive Compression
identity.summary: Attacker discovers and stages sensitive customer data files (PII/PCI) in temporary directories and creates encrypted ZIP/7z archives to evade basic content filters.
identity.description: Adversaries routinely collect sensitive records into central directories and compress them with password encryption prior to exfiltration. Cortex XDR Behavioral Threat Protection flags command-line parameters specifying passwords alongside archive utilities operating on structured sensitive data files.

techniques.name: Archive Collected Data: Archive via Utility

prerequisites.description: Cortex XDR Agent active on test endpoint.

biocs.name: Sensitive Data Staging Tmp
biocs.logic: preset = xdr_data | filter event_type = 'FILE_WRITE' and action_file_name contains 'customer_pii' and (action_file_path contains '/tmp/' or action_file_path contains 'AppData')

biocs.name: Archive Password Encryption
biocs.logic: preset = xdr_data | filter action_process_image_name in ('zip', '7z', '7za', 'rar', 'tar') and (action_process_command_line contains '-p' or action_process_command_line contains '-P' or action_process_command_line contains '--password') | filter action_process_command_line contains 'exfil' or action_process_command_line contains 'archive'

xql_queries.name: Password Protected Archive Command Analysis
xql_queries.query: dataset = xdr_data | filter event_type = 'PROCESS_EXEC' and action_process_image_name in ('zip', '7z', '7za', 'rar') and (action_process_command_line contains '-P' or action_process_command_line contains '-p') | comp count() as execs by agent_hostname, actor_process_username | filter execs >= 1

correlation_rules.name: Sensitive File Staging Followed by Encrypted Archive Creation
correlation_rules.logic: Sequence: File Write (Sensitive Marker) -> Process Exec (Zip/7z Password Encrypted) within 300s by same user

products.evidence_query: dataset = xdr_data | filter action_process_image_name in ('zip', '7z') and action_process_command_line contains '-P'

references.title: Unit 42 Playbook: Modern Extortion and Archive Tactics
